<meta name="DC.description" content="We give a smooth autonomous observed system on a connected closed genus-three surface whose exact finite-time differential observation Gramian is complete and has constant negative sectional curvature, although every attained output history corresponds to exactly two initial states. The system has zero dynamics and a Euclidean-valued output obtained by composing a connected double cover of a closed hyperbolic surface with a smooth Nash isometric embedding into ℝ¹⁷. For each fixed T > 0 its Gramian is P_T = Tπ*g and its curvature is −1/T. Uniform positive upper and lower bounds hold in a fixed finite normalized atlas and relative to any fixed smooth background metric. This refutes the manifold implication printed in Krener's 2009 open problem under those coherent meanings of its coordinate bounds. The construction is an application of classical constructions. A bounded primary-source audit found no earlier explicit complete construction in the inspected corpus; no absolute historical firstness is asserted.">
